Hymn 57: We're Not Ashamed to Own Our Lord
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: A-flat Major
Composer: David Calder
Lyricist/Text Author: Isaac Watts
Category: Praise to the Lord

This is hymn number 57 titled "We're Not Ashamed to Own Our Lord" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in A-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by David Calder and the lyrics were written by Isaac Watts.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
